verdict.rationale: React docs explicitly describe server-side streaming HTML that progressively fills in content before JS loads, which underlies progressive/selective hydration for faster interactivity, and frameworks built on React (Next.js, React Router) implement this pattern. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of selective/partial hydration mechanics, independent hands-on benchmarks confirming faster interactivity, and community corroboration of the hydration experience itself.
